items.html: And behold, her NHY have not yet entered within the internality, in the secret of Mochin, as it is in Gadlut; rather, they rose from the outside, like a mother who raises her son between her thighs to nurse him from her breasts, which are between her two arms. And afterward, when the time of the aforementioned Gadlut comes, then the NHY of Tvuna enter within the internality of the head of Zeir Anpin, in the secret of Mochin of Gadlut, as said there, God willing.
